units: HH and G1-G4 MAD sigma in linear Rec.2020 Y/Co/Cg; error=log2(P/differential reference)
rules: <=256 evenly spaced grid tiles per original A Y bin; nested deterministic ranks per seed; 0/10/25/50/100 percent contaminated per bin; zero-mean Hann-tapered fine/coarse sinusoids, texture RMS=local D sample SD; fixed P envelopes/factors and bins, D/quiet unchanged; median >=16 compatible, truth >=8 sampled quiet; G1-G4 includes neighbouring injections with radius16 context
